name: Dark Thaumaturgy (Fires of the Inferno) — 2 Intermediate — Incinerate

system.description: Conjures a pillar of hellfire from the ground beneath a target. Win a Mental Challenge resisted by the target's Physical Traits to inflict two levels of aggravated damage immediately, plus one further level of aggravated damage each subsequent turn until the fire is extinguished or the victim dies; the victim may retest with Dodge.
